motifs.name: acid
motifs.note: the line: two bars of sixteenths in chord tones. Root and octave, accents off the beat, a slide into the fifth; the second bar leans on the flat second and leaps to the high fifth. The rests are where the kick is heard

motifs.name: acid_turn
motifs.note: the same pattern started six steps in: every accent lands somewhere new against the kick

motifs.name: acid_back
motifs.note: backwards, for the square-wave machine an octave above

motifs.name: roll
motifs.note: the rolling bass: the root on the three sixteenths the kick does not take

motifs.name: roll_push
motifs.note: the same, leaning on the off-beat eighth

motifs.name: hook
motifs.note: eight bars. A figure in dotted eighths -- three, three, three, three, four -- that leaps a fourth and falls back, then a held note; restated on the sixth and the fourth, each time reaching higher, then on the flat second, and left on the leading tone, unresolved

motifs.name: hook_head
motifs.note: its first bar alone: heard in the drop before the theme has been stated

ops.note: up through the dominant chord, two octaves and a fifth, every note slid: the one bar where nothing else plays
a second filter over the machine's own, for the long moves
the hook starts dull and opens as the roll arrives
the hook again a dotted eighth later, off to one side
in the break it only holds the root, shut
bar 32 has no kick: the drop is a subtraction first
it comes back under the roll
the roll climbs in pitch into the drop
a few percent: enough that the sixteenths lean
